title: Prayer for a Family
text: Lord, bless our family, all of us now together, those far away, all who are gone back to you. May we know joy. May we bear our sorrows in patience. Let love guide our understanding of each other. Let us be grateful to each other. We have all made each other what we are. O Family of Jesus, watch over our family.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
